definitions: To say or do something foolish, embarrassing, or tactless.
To inadvertently say something that offends or upsets someone.
examples: I really stuck my foot in my mouth when I asked her about her ex-husband.
He's always sticking his foot in his mouth at family gatherings.
I tried not to stick my foot in my mouth during the important meeting.
lemma: stick one's foot in one's mouth
source: stick my foot in my mouth
